verdicts.criticalReason: PR #1610 directly contradicts the Acceptance Criteria and Atomic Goal. The original brief mandated fixing a CI failure where endpoints return 401 instead of 200/201 (e.g. EmployeeDossierControllerTest) and asserting secure Set-Cookie delivery in AuthControllerTest. The PR instead implements an atomic guarded update for dossier report completion (DossierReportRepository completeReport) and modifies EmployeeDossierAnalyticsController and EmployeeDossierController, failing to touch AuthControllerTest or fix the specific test failures mandated by the original brief and AC.
